does: Makes the bare entity of an effect: a new entity with ls::VisualComponent, ls::EffectComponent, ls::TransformComponent and the one-frame EffectCreate tag, and ls::LevelComponent copied from the level entity when that carries ls::LevelInstanceStateComponent.

evidence.says: The component adds are in that order; the level's handle is checked for LevelInstanceState before Level is added with RootLevel set to it; bit 0x100 of the effect component's word at +0x60 is set.

questions.ask: Reached only through unplaced::CreateEffectFromResource: confirm with a probe while a client effect is played.
